completion:

4. Check the cable: Check that the plug and cord are in good condition and that they are fitted. Label them if they are fine.
5. Visual test - check the following: The visible structure should not show any severe shocks, such as a crack opening the case or metal deformation, although any cracks or dents that are considered to be caused by direct shocks should not be considered unsafe; The case or connection box should not be drilled holes or show a metal block along the circuit; All screws, joints and connections should be in place and undamaged; If there are any cuts in the cable, they should be washed away. The cable should not be knotted or twisted, and it should be connected to the screw-type terminal. It should not be used to fix the cable along the surface of sharp metalwork, as the screw-type cord clamp should be used for metal. Connecting. ;
